actions.name: Frost Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (3d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Magma Mephit
monsters.description: Magma Mephit from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Steam Mephit
monsters.description: Steam Mephit from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Blurred Form
traits.description: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit’s next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this Fire damage.

monsters.name: Merfolk Skirmisher
monsters.description: Merfolk Skirmisher from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Ocean Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the merfolk’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.

monsters.name: Merrow
monsters.description: Merrow from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The merrow can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow’s next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Harpoon
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.description: Mimic from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
traits.description: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

monsters.name: Minotaur of Baphomet
monsters.description: Minotaur of Baphomet from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Abyssal Glaive
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gore (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

monsters.name: Mummy
monsters.description: Mummy from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this mummy’s Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

monsters.name: Mummy Lord
monsters.description: Mummy Lord from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.description: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy’s lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.

actions.name: Channel Negative Energy
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague (level 7 version)

reactions.name: Whirlwind of Sand
reactions.description: Trigger: The mummy is hit by an attack roll. Response: The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Dread Command
legendaryActions.description: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Glare
legendaryActions.description: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Necrotic Strike
legendaryActions.description: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

monsters.name: Nalfeshnee
monsters.description: Nalfeshnee from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Demonic Restoration
traits.description: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The nalfeshnee has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) Force damage.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

bonusActions.name: Horror Nimbus (Recharge 5–6)
bonusActions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nalfeshnee. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. Success: The target is immune to this nalfeshnee’s Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

reactions.name: Pursuit
reactions.description: Trigger: Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. Response: The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.

monsters.name: Night Hag
monsters.description: Night Hag from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.description: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The hag has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Soul Bag
traits.description: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action. The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and Resistance to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day; Requires Soul Bag)
actions.description: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts Dream, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell’s messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the Protection from Evil and Good spell or within a Magic Circle spell. If the target takes damage from the Dream spell, the target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag’s soul bag, and the target can’t be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Etherealness, Magic Missile (level 4 version)

actions.name: 2/Day Each:
actions.description: Phantasmal Killer, Plane Shift (self only)

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

monsters.name: Nightmare
monsters.description: Nightmare from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: Understands Abyssal, Common, and Infernal but can’t speak

traits.name: Confer Fire Resistance
traits.description: The nightmare can grant Resistance to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.description: The nightmare sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Ethereal Stride
actions.description: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.

monsters.name: Noble
monsters.description: Noble from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.description: Trigger: The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

monsters.name: Nothic
monsters.description: Nothic from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The nothic makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Rotting Gaze
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the nothic can see within 120 feet. Failure: 17 (5d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage.

bonusActions.name: Weird Insight (Recharge 6)
bonusActions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the nothic can see within 120 feet. Failure: The nothic magically learns one fact or secret about the target.

monsters.name: Ochre Jelly
monsters.description: Ochre Jelly from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.

reactions.name: Split
reactions.description: Trigger: While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its Initiative. The original jelly’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

monsters.name: Ogre
monsters.description: Ogre from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Oni
monsters.description: Oni from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The oni regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Nightmare Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition until the start of the oni’s next turn.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.description: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Charm Person (level 2 version), Darkness, Gaseous Form, Sleep

bonusActions.name: Invisibility
bonusActions.description: The oni casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Otyugh
monsters.description: Otyugh from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: telepathy 120 ft. (doesn’t allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15. Failure: The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10) and doesn’t return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two tentacles.

actions.name: Tentacle Slam
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature Grappled by the otyugh. Failure: 16 (3d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Stunned condition until the start of the otyugh’s next turn. Success: Half damage only.

monsters.name: Owlbear
monsters.description: Owlbear from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Pegasus
monsters.description: Pegasus from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: Understands Celestial, Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can’t speak

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

monsters.name: Phase Spider
monsters.description: Phase Spider from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.description: The spider can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane while on the Material Plane and vice versa.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Web Walker
traits.description: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spider makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Poison damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the target becomes Stable, and it has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the Paralyzed condition.

bonusActions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
bonusActions.description: The spider teleports from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

monsters.name: Pirate
monsters.description: Pirate from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pirate makes two Dagger attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Enthralling Panache.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enthralling Panache
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate’s next turn.

monsters.name: Pirate Captain
monsters.description: Pirate Captain from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage, and the pirate has Advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of this turn.

actions.name: Pistol
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +7, range 30/90 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

bonusActions.name: Captain’s Charm
bonusActions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 14, one creature the pirate can see within 30 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the start of the pirate’s next turn.

reactions.name: Riposte
reactions.description: Trigger: The pirate is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The pirate adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, the pirate makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.

monsters.name: Pit Fiend
monsters.description: Pit Fiend from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
traits.description: If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

traits.name: Fear Aura
traits.description: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this pit fiend’s aura for 24 hours.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The pit fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target can’t regain Hit Points and takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Devilish Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Fiery Mace
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) Force damage plus 21 (6d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Hellfire Spellcasting (Recharge 4–6)
actions.description: The pit fiend casts Fireball (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21). It can replace one Fireball with Hold Monster (level 7 version) or Wall of Fire.

monsters.name: Planetar
monsters.description: Planetar from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.description: If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.

actions.name: Radiant Sword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Holy Burst
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Evil and Good

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead

bonusActions.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
bonusActions.description: The planetar casts Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Priest Acolyte
monsters.description: Priest Acolyte from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 60 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Light, Thaumaturgy

bonusActions.name: Divine Aid (1/Day)
bonusActions.description: The priest casts Bless, Healing Word, or Sanctuary, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Priest
monsters.description: Priest from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The priest makes two attacks, using Mace or Radiant Flame in any combination.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Flame
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Light, Thaumaturgy

actions.name: 1/Day:
actions.description: Spirit Guardians

bonusActions.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
bonusActions.description: The priest casts Bless, Dispel Magic, Healing Word, or Lesser Restoration, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

monsters.name: Pseudodragon
monsters.description: Pseudodragon from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: Understands Common and Draconic but can’t speak

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The pseudodragon has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The pseudodragon makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the pseudodragon can see within 5 feet. Failure: 5 (2d4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition for 1 hour. While Poisoned, the target also has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

monsters.name: Purple Worm
monsters.description: Purple Worm from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.description: The worm can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The worm makes one Bite attack and one Tail Stinger attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: Tail Stinger
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d6 + 9) Piercing damage plus 35 (10d6) Poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the worm, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 17 (5d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the worm’s turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the worm and has the Prone condition. If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

monsters.name: Quasit
monsters.description: Quasit from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The quasit has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the quasit’s next turn.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The quasit casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

actions.name: Scare (1/Day)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 20 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Shape-Shift
actions.description: The quasit shape-shifts to resemble a bat (Speed 10 ft., Fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., Climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., Swim 40 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

monsters.name: Rakshasa
monsters.description: Rakshasa from the Basic Rules (2024).
damageVulnerabilities: Piercing damage from weapons wielded by creatures under the effect of a Bless spell

traits.name: Greater Magic Resistance
traits.description: The rakshasa automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and the attack rolls of spells automatically miss it. Without the rakshasa’s permission, no spell can observe the rakshasa remotely or detect its thoughts, creature type, or alignment.

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: If the rakshasa dies outside the Nine Hells, its body turns to ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rakshasa makes three Cursed Touch attacks.

actions.name: Cursed Touch
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 19 (3d12) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target gains no benefit from finishing a Short or Long Rest.

actions.name: Baleful Command (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each enemy in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the rakshasa. Failure: 28 (8d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened and Incapacitated conditions until the start of the rakshasa’s next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The rakshasa casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Disguise Self, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Fly, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift

monsters.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.description: Red Dragon Wyrmling from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 24 (7d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Young Red Dragon
monsters.description: Young Red Dragon from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 56 (16d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Adult Red Dragon
monsters.description: Adult Red Dragon from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (1d10 + 8) Slashing damage plus 5 (2d4) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 59 (17d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20, +12 to hit with spell attacks):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Command (level 2 version), Detect Magic, Scorching Ray

actions.name: 1/Day:
actions.description: Fireball

legendaryActions.name: Commanding Presence
legendaryActions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Command (level 2 version). The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Fiery Rays
legendaryActions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray. The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.description: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

monsters.name: Ancient Red Dragon
monsters.description: Ancient Red Dragon from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray (level 3 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 91 (26d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Command (level 2 version), Detect Magic, Scorching Ray (level 3 version)

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Fireball (level 6 version), Scrying

legendaryActions.name: Commanding Presence
legendaryActions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Command (level 2 version). The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Fiery Rays
legendaryActions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Scorching Ray (level 3 version). The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.description: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

monsters.name: Remorhaz
monsters.description: Remorhaz from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Heat Aura
traits.description: At the end of each of the remorhaz’s turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the remorhaz takes 16 (3d10) Fire damage.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 17), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the remorhaz (it can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed by the remorhaz, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the remorhaz, and it takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage at the start of each of the remorhaz’s turns. If the remorhaz takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the remorhaz must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 5 feet of the remorhaz and has the Prone condition. If the remorhaz dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

monsters.name: Roc
monsters.description: Roc from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roc makes two Beak attacks. It can replace one attack with a Talons attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 28 (3d12 + 9) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) from both talons, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

bonusActions.name: Swoop (Recharge 5–6)
bonusActions.description: If the roc has a creature Grappled, the roc flies up to half its Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and drops that creature.

monsters.name: Roper
monsters.description: Roper from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: The roper can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The roper makes two Tentacle attacks, uses Reel, and makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 60 ft. Hit: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of six tentacles, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the grapple ends. The tentacle can be damaged, freeing a creature it has Grappled when destroyed (AC 20, HP 10, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage). Damaging the tentacle deals no damage to the roper, and a destroyed tentacle regrows at the start of the roper’s next turn.

actions.name: Reel
actions.description: The roper pulls each creature Grappled by it up to 30 feet straight toward it.

monsters.name: Rust Monster
monsters.description: Rust Monster from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Iron Scent
traits.description: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Antennae
actions.description: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure: The object takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.

actions.name: Destroy Metal
actions.description: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn’t being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.

reactions.name: Reflexive Antennae
reactions.description: Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae.

monsters.name: Sahuagin Warrior
monsters.description: Sahuagin Warrior from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Blood Frenzy
traits.description: The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its Hit Points.

traits.name: Limited Amphibiousness
traits.description: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.

traits.name: Shark Telepathy
traits.description: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.

bonusActions.name: Aquatic Charge
bonusActions.description: The sahuagin swims up to its Swim Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

monsters.name: Salamander
monsters.description: Salamander from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Fire Aura
traits.description: At the end of each of the salamander’s turns, each creature of the salamander’s choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the salamander takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The salamander makes two Flame Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Constrict.

actions.name: Flame Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the salamander’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet. Failure: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.

monsters.name: Satyr
monsters.description: Satyr from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Mockery
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. Failure: 5 (1d6 + 2) Psychic damage.

monsters.name: Scout
monsters.description: Scout from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Sea Hag
monsters.description: Sea Hag from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Coven Magic
traits.description: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.

traits.name: Vile Appearance
traits.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag’s true form. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this hag’s Vile Appearance for 24 hours.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Death Glare (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one Frightened creature the hag can see within 30 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.description: The hag casts Disguise Self, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The spell’s duration is 24 hours.

monsters.name: Shadow
monsters.description: Shadow from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

traits.name: Sunlight Weakness
traits.description: While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

actions.name: Draining Swipe
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target’s Strength score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.

bonusActions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonusActions.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.

monsters.name: Shambling Mound
monsters.description: Shambling Mound from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The shambling mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

actions.name: Charged Tendril
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the shambling mound pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target is pulled into the shambling mound’s space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.

monsters.name: Shield Guardian
monsters.description: Shield Guardian from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: Understands commands given in any language but can’t speak

traits.name: Bound
traits.description: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet’s wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet’s wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

traits.name: Spell Storing
traits.description: A spellcaster who wears the guardian’s amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster’s spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

actions.name: Fist
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.

reactions.name: Protection
reactions.description: Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian’s amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian’s next turn.

monsters.name: Silver Dragon Wyrmling
monsters.description: Silver Dragon Wyrmling from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

monsters.name: Young Silver Dragon
monsters.description: Young Silver Dragon from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 49 (11d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

monsters.name: Adult Silver Dragon
monsters.description: Adult Silver Dragon from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Paralyzing Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast Ice Knife.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 54 (12d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19, +11 to hit with spell attacks):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Ice Knife, Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Ice Storm (level 5 version), Zone of Truth

legendaryActions.name: Chill
legendaryActions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Hold Monster. The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Cold Gale
legendaryActions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Cold damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.description: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

monsters.name: Ancient Silver Dragon
monsters.description: Ancient Silver Dragon from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Paralyzing Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast Ice Knife (level 2 version).

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 15 ft. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Cold damage.

actions.name: Cold Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. Failure: 67 (15d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Paralyzing Breath
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 24, each creature in a 90-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 23, +15 to hit with spell attacks):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Hold Monster, Ice Knife (level 2 version), Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell)

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Control Weather, Ice Storm (level 7 version), Teleport, Zone of Truth

legendaryActions.name: Chill
legendaryActions.description: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Hold Monster. The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Cold Gale
legendaryActions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Cold damage, and the target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: The dragon can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce
legendaryActions.description: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

monsters.name: Skeleton
monsters.description: Skeleton from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can’t speak

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Minotaur Skeleton
monsters.description: Minotaur Skeleton from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Gore
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.

monsters.name: Slaad Tadpole
monsters.description: Slaad Tadpole from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The slaad has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Solar
monsters.description: Solar from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.description: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Exalted Restoration
traits.description: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
traits.description: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.

actions.name: Flying Sword
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) Slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage. Hit or Miss: The sword magically returns to the solar’s hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.

actions.name: Slaying Bow
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the solar can see within 600 feet. Failure: If the creature has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes 24 (4d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The solar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Evil and Good

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Resurrection

bonusActions.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
bonusActions.description: The solar casts Cure Wounds (level 2 version), Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

legendaryActions.name: Blinding Gaze
legendaryActions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the solar can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success: The solar can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendaryActions.name: Radiant Teleport
legendaryActions.description: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the solar at its destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Specter
monsters.description: Specter from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: Understands Common plus one other language but can’t speak

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.description: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

monsters.name: Sphinx of Lore
monsters.description: Sphinx of Lore from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Mind-Rending Roar (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, each enemy in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the sphinx’s next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues

legendaryActions.name: Arcane Prowl
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Weight of Years
legendaryActions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Sphinx of Valor
monsters.description: Sphinx of Valor from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.description: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.description: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Roar (3/Day)
actions.description: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest):

actions.name: First Roar
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Second Roar
actions.description: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: Third Roar
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Evil and Good, Thaumaturgy

actions.name: 1/Day Each:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Greater Restoration, Heroes’ Feast, Zone of Truth

legendaryActions.name: Arcane Prowl
legendaryActions.description: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Weight of Years
legendaryActions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Sphinx of Wonder
monsters.description: Sphinx of Wonder from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.

reactions.name: Burst of Ingenuity (2/Day)
reactions.description: Trigger: The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. Response: The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.

monsters.name: Spirit Naga
monsters.description: Spirit Naga from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Fiendish Restoration
traits.description: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Necrotic Ray
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Water Breathing

actions.name: 2/Day Each:
actions.description: Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Hold Person (level 3 version), Lightning Bolt (level 4 version)

monsters.name: Sprite
monsters.description: Sprite from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Needle Sword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

actions.name: Enchanting Bow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite’s next turn.

actions.name: Heart Sight
actions.description: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target’s emotions and alignment.

actions.name: Invisibility
actions.description: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

monsters.name: Spy
monsters.description: Spy from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

bonusActions.name: Cunning Action
bonusActions.description: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

monsters.name: Stirge
monsters.description: Stirge from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Proboscis
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can’t make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge’s turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.

monsters.name: Stone Giant
monsters.description: Stone Giant from the Basic Rules (2024).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

actions.name: Stone Club
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Boulder
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile (Recharge 5–6)
reactions.description: Trigger: The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. Response: The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack’s force. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.

monsters.name: Stone Golem
monsters.description: Stone Golem from the Basic Rules (2024).
languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can’t speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.description: The golem can’t shape-shift.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

actions.name: Force Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Force damage.

bonusActions.name: Slow (Recharge 5–6)
bonusActions.description: The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

monsters.name: Storm Giant
monsters.description: Storm Giant from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The giant can breathe air and water.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.

actions.name: Storm Sword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Thunderbolt
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 500 ft. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) Lightning damage, and the target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions until the start of the giant’s next turn.

actions.name: Lightning Storm (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):

actions.name: At Will:
actions.description: Detect Magic, Light

actions.name: 1/Day:
actions.description: Control Weather

monsters.name: Succubus
monsters.description: Succubus from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Incubus Form
traits.description: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

actions.name: Fiendish Touch
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.

actions.name: Charm
actions.description: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).

actions.name: Draining Kiss
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

bonusActions.name: Shape-Shift
bonusActions.description: The succubus shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its Fly Speed is available only in its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.

monsters.name: Tarrasque
monsters.description: Tarrasque from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
traits.description: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The tarrasque has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reflective Carapace
traits.description: If the tarrasque is targeted by a Magic Missile spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll 1d6. On a 1–5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 36 (4d12 + 10) Piercing damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition and can’t teleport.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 15 ft. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +19, reach 30 ft. Hit: 23 (3d8 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Thunderous Bellow (Recharge 5–6)
actions.description: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 27, each creature and each object that isn’t being worn or carried in a 150-foot Cone. Failure: 78 (12d12) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened and Frightened conditions until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

bonusActions.name: Swallow
bonusActions.description: Strength Saving Throw: DC 27, one Large or smaller creature Grappled by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions and can’t teleport, it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 (16d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque’s turns. If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the Prone condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

legendaryActions.name: Onslaught
legendaryActions.description: The tarrasque moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendaryActions.name: World-Shaking Movement
legendaryActions.description: The tarrasque moves up to its Speed. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose Concentration and, if Medium or smaller, have the Prone condition. The tarrasque can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Tough
monsters.description: Tough from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Mace
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Tough Boss
monsters.description: Tough Boss from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.description: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tough makes two attacks, using Warhammer or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.

actions.name: Warhammer
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the tough pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 13 (2d10 + 2) Piercing damage.

monsters.name: Treant
monsters.description: Treant from the Basic Rules (2024).

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The treant deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The treant makes two Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hail of Bark
